name: Heat Oxidized Brushed Titanium
author: Bad Pixel (BlenderKit)
licence: Royalty free (BlenderKit RF: commercial OK, no resale of the asset)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Radial (circular) brushing + anisotropic + blue/violet/gold heat-tint colour shift; controls Heat Position/Spread. Closest free match to spun anodized iridescent metal. Uploaded 2026-10-07, no ratings yet.

name: Liquid Thin Film Chrome
author: Bad Pixel (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Liquid chrome with thin-film colour shift, ripples and fine brushing; Film Thickness / Liquid Ripple params. Uploaded 2026-10-07, no ratings yet.

name: Circular Brushed Metal
author: Apicedda (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Procedural radial/circular anisotropic brushing (tags: radial, anisotropic). Plain steel colour; add Principled Thin Film for iridescence.

name: Procedural Anisotropic Metal
author: danes_dysfunction (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Radial anisotropic highlights on stainless steel; Cycles only (EEVEE ignores anisotropy).

name: Iridescent Steel
author: NK Productions (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Brushed steel with subtle iridescent reflections; linear brushing, not radial. Top-rated (score 500).

name: Anisotropic Brushed Metal
author: DJ SOLANA (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Linear hairline brushed aluminium/steel with real anisotropic reflections.

name: Brushed chrome
author: antoine f (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Fine linear micro-scratches, anisotropic reflection; appliance/hardware finish. 2026-05.

name: Polished Chrome Metal
author: RADHUNANDAN (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. High-gloss, minimal roughness chrome/mirror. Honestly a stock Principled (Metallic 1, Roughness ~0.02) gets you 95% there.

name: Mercury
author: Nikhil G krishnan (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Liquid-metal silver look. 2026-08.

name: Metal 051 A (circular brushed aluminium)
author: ambientCG (Lennart Demes)
note: Scanned/authored circular brushed aluminium (tags: aluminum, brushed, circular). Variants 051B/051C. Map the roughness/normal planar on a disc; add Principled Thin Film for anodized colour. Released 2024-08.

name: Metal 009 (brushed steel)
author: ambientCG
note: Linear brushed silver steel. Older set (2018) but clean; siblings Metal011/012.

name: Brushed Metal 1
author: Share Textures
note: Linear brushed metal PBR set.

name: Procedural metal shader (2 shaders)
author: mart0nnn (Gumroad)
licence: Royalty free: commercial OK, no resale
note: Two procedural metallic node groups; also part of Curtis Holt Community Material Pack v3.

name: Thin-film interference and metals with complex refractive index
author: prutser (BlendSwap)
note: Physically based thin-film over metal using n/k per RGB; good for anodized/oxide colours on any metal (incl. spun). Old file (~10 yrs, updated for 3.0); in 4.2+ the Principled Thin Film input covers most of this.

name: Principled BSDF: Thin Film + Anisotropic (built in)
author: Blender Foundation
note: Cycles-only Thin Film (thickness nm + IOR) and Anisotropic + Rotation + Tangent. Spun metal recipe: Metallic 1, Anisotropic ~0.8, Tangent node set to Radial Z (object-centred), Thin Film 300-800 nm / IOR ~2.0 (TiO2/Al2O3). 4.2 notes said thin film was dielectric-only at first; metallic thin film support in current versions [U]. No dedicated Dispersion input found in the 5.2 manual [U].

name: Real Aesthetic Glass
author: Paco Salas (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Clear refractive glass with chromatic dispersion / rainbow highlights (faked RGB-split). Highly rated.

name: Frosted Glass 02
author: Paco Salas (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Satin-etched frosted glass, softened refraction. Top-rated.

name: Procedural Frosted Glass
author: eatnoodls (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Frosted glass with volumetrics; old (2021) but opens in 4.x [U].

name: Realistic Eevee Glass Shader
author: Ryan King Art (Gumroad)
note: 2 glass .blends + HDRIs. Built for EEVEE Next; how it reads in Cycles is [U]. Same product on Superhive lists $2.

name: Glass Frosted 001
author: 3dtextures.me (Joao Paulo)
note: Roughness/normal maps for frosted pattern; plug into a Glass/Principled transmission shader.

name: Paper 001 (white)
author: ambientCG
note: Plain white paper with fibre texture. Add low SSS / sheen for coated cup board. Paper003 = white creased; Paper005/Cardboard00x are brown.

name: Paper
author: antoine f (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. White paper with detailed fibre; 2K seamless.

name: White paper
author: ydd 3D (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Simple clean white paper. 2025-11.

name: Plastic 010 (white smooth)
author: ambientCG
note: Smooth white plastic; scale roughness map for satin vs gloss. Plastic006 = black shiny; Plastic012-018 (2023) = coloured series.

name: Glossy Plastic
author: Paco Salas (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. High-sheen moulded polymer; top-rated.

name: Dusty Sheen Plastic
author: Paco Salas (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Satin/silky sheen moulded plastic with finish variation.

name: Electronic matte plastic
author: Jon 13 (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Dull satin housing plastic for electronics.

name: Procedural Ceramic
author: Matheus Godoi (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. White ceramic with several parameters (gloss can be dialled down for bisque) [U].

name: Porcelain
author: Andrey Livintsov (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Simple glossy white porcelain; CC0.

name: Ceramic Unglazed
author: Jammer Jamski (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. Unglazed (bisque) ceramic shader; old (2020).

name: Glazed Ceramic Black
author: James Middleton (BlenderKit)
note: BlenderKit free tier: needs a free BlenderKit account + add-on to download. 100% procedural wobbly glaze; recolour base for white.

name: Porcelain 001 (white)
author: ambientCG
note: White porcelain surface maps (2021); raise roughness for bisque. Porcelain002 = with smears.

name: Procedural Ceramics Shader (V1 free)
author: secretswimclub (Gumroad)
licence: Free for commercial/personal use; no redistribution
